Your whole family are thrilled to congratulate you as you graduate from Franklin Classical School. This occasion marks your successful achievement in an important journey, one that started early at Trinity Classical, continued at Cambridge Classical, and now this milestone at Franklin Classical. It has been our hope that you would come to recognize the unique privilege of education in the unique tradition of Christian Classical Education.  

We are proud of you for your diligence and your seeking to excel in each level and subject, even though, of course, not every class could be your favorite. We commend you for being wise enough to learn from your teachers' instruction, personal example, and counsel during those times when life became difficult or confusing. Your sports coaches also had a big part in this. The Lord was and is using these experiences to mature you into a young man He can guide and enable for your service to Him in many future circumstances.  

We’ve also watched your character for self-improvement develop in meaningful ways — your willingness to take responsibility, your growing humility, and your desire to do better each day have truly stood out. We are proud not only of your accomplishments but of the growth we’ve seen in who you are becoming.  

The journey continues, but you have the Bible as your map and your Savior as your guide. May you live a discerning and useful life, always relying on this firm foundation. May God's amazing blessings be yours through all the days He gives.
